sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE "superhero" (
  "XCL_018" integer,
  "XCL_019" text,
  "XCL_020" text,
  "XCL_021" integer,
  "XCL_022" integer,
  "XCL_023" integer,
  "XCL_024" integer,
  "XCL_025" integer,
  "XCL_026" integer,
  "XCL_027" integer,
  "XCL_028" integer,
  "XCL_029" integer
);

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each alignment type.
The name or label of the alignment, such as Good, Bad, Neutral, or N/A.

prediction.purpose: Stores the possible moral or ethical alignments for superheroes, villains, and other characters.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each attribute type.
The name or type of a superhero attribute, such as Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, or Power.

prediction.purpose: Defines the types of attributes (e.g., Intelligence, Strength) that superheroes can possess, used as a lookup table for hero_attribute assignments.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each colour entry.
The name or description of the colour, e.g., 'Black', 'Amber', 'No Colour'.

prediction.purpose: Lookup table mapping numeric IDs to colour names for superhero attributes such as skin, hair, and eye colour.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each gender/sex category.
Text label describing the gender/sex category (e.g., Male, Female, N/A).

prediction.purpose: Stores a lookup of gender/sex identifiers and their textual labels for superhero entities.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each publisher.
The name of the publisher or media company.

prediction.purpose: Stores information about comic book publishers and media companies that produce superhero content.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each race or species.
The name or label of the race or species, such as Alien, Amazon, or Android.

prediction.purpose: Stores the distinct race or species categories that a superhero can belong to, used as a lookup table for the superhero table.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each superhero.
The public or code name of the superhero (e.g., 3-D Man, A-Bomb).
The real or full name of the superhero (e.g., Charles Chandler, Abraham Sapien).
Foreign key to the gender reference table indicating the superhero's gender.
Foreign key to the colour reference table indicating the superhero's eye colour.
Foreign key to the colour reference table indicating the superhero's hair colour.
Foreign key to the colour reference table indicating the superhero's skin colour.
Foreign key to the race reference table indicating the superhero's race or species.
Foreign key to the publisher reference table indicating the comic publisher (e.g., Marvel, DC).
Foreign key to the alignment reference table indicating the superhero's moral alignment (e.g., good, bad, neutral).
Height of the superhero in centimeters.
Weight of the superhero in kilograms.

prediction.purpose: Stores core biographical and physical attributes of superhero characters, including their names, physical characteristics, and identifiers linking to reference tables for gender, eye colour, hair colour, skin colour, race, publisher, and alignment.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier for a superhero, used to link to the hero table.
Unique identifier for a specific attribute (e.g., strength, speed), used to link to the attribute table.
Numeric value representing the hero's level for a given attribute (e.g., strength score of 95).

prediction.purpose: Stores numeric attribute values (e.g., strength, speed, intelligence) for each superhero, linking heroes to their specific attributes.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique numeric identifier for each superpower.
The descriptive name of a superpower or ability.

prediction.purpose: Stores a catalog of distinct superpowers or abilities that can be assigned to superheroes.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Unique identifier referencing a superhero in the superhero table.
Unique identifier referencing a superpower in the superpower table.

prediction.purpose: Associates heroes with their superpowers, linking each hero to one or more powers.
